name: deer
about: A deer: about 90 cm at the shoulder, a brown coat, a light belly, long legs, large ears.
sources: A deer of the size of a white-tailed deer: 80 to 100 cm at the shoulder. The deer of Việt Nam (nai, Rusa unicolor) are larger: 1.2 to 1.4 m (the option size).
The lengths of the fur (fur): a guess from photos of the animal, not a measurement.
